purpose: Independent preregistered fresh native negative-control and reversible rank11 low-hand legal Marnie/Carmine source policy. This tests source choice competence only, not a deck or win rate. Every game, cap, abort and zero-opportunity persists.
triggerPolicy: On source low-hand native PassTurnAction (never before the existing root policy). Turn 1 going first Carmine if hand <=2 no protected companion. Marnie on other turns if hand <=4. Native canPlay, opponent-hidden-zone abstention, paper first-turn quota.
seedMethod: Eight uniformly sampled 32-bit secrets via Python secrets.randbelow(2**32), no resampling, drawn before any new native trial; shared physical seed per candidate-policy pair; same seed also paired by candidate inventory but inventory changes make source opening not guaranteed identical.
metrics: source own-hand Supporter Pass opportunities and accepted Marnie/Carmine roots
actual native source first player and physical source opening digest
root-ledger equality until first proposed source Supporter
source rank11 early Boost Shake+Tool Garbodor line receipts
source turns, action caps and source AttackAction counts
qualification: All attempted observations remain development-only. No policy paper-fidelity or clock qualification; neither terminal winner nor guessed win-rate signifies competitive win.
acceptance: No altered seeds or suppressions after seeing outcomes. Do not reinterpret no-supporter attempts as baseline strength. Keep every failed, censored and actual-first arm. If new repairs needed, precommit new cohort.
